models.architecture_or_algorithm: Attentive deep learning model (ensemble of five sub-models)
models.candidate_reason: Original AMP prediction model with reported state-of-the-art performance; provides model files and training/test data.

models.architecture_or_algorithm: Dual-stream ensemble: ESM-2 embeddings + knowledge-based physicochemical features, CARE conservative adaptive residual encoder, ProBiMamba bidirectional Mamba, cross-modal attention
models.candidate_reason: Multi-functional DL AMP predictor with code available, clear benchmark and independent test sets, and strong performance.

models.architecture_or_algorithm: Graph neural network (GNN) with weight-enhanced contrastive learning and pseudo-label distillation. Uses OmegaFold for 3D structure prediction, constructs Cα-atom graphs, and a GNN encoder.
models.input_features: One-hot encoded amino acid sequences transformed into 3D Cα-atom graphs (node features + spatial distances)
models.dataset_source_or_link: not_reported_in_available_evidence (paper states 'publicly available AMP and non-AMP datasets')
models.candidate_reason: Novel GNN-based AMP classifier with publicly available code; proposes a structure-aware approach and addresses class imbalance.

models.architecture_or_algorithm: Convolutional neural network (CNN) on contextualized embeddings from pretrained protein language models
models.input_features: Contextualized amino acid sequence embeddings from language models
models.candidate_reason: Only mentioned in review; original paper not verified here.

models.architecture_or_algorithm: Bidirectional LSTM (Bi-LSTM) with attention mechanism and ensemble strategy
models.input_features: Amino acid sequences (one-hot or learned embeddings)

aliases: Therapeutic peptide language model multi-scale graph neural network
models.task_type: therapeutic peptide prediction (including AMP, antiviral, anticancer)
models.architecture_or_algorithm: Multi-scale graph neural network integrating language model embeddings, physicochemical descriptors, and structural encodings
models.input_features: Peptide sequences represented as graphs with multiple feature types
models.candidate_reason: Only mentioned in review; multi-task therapeutic peptide model.

models.architecture_or_algorithm: Graph attention network (GAT) for residue-level interactions
models.candidate_reason: Only mentioned in review; GAT-based AMP predictor.

models.architecture_or_algorithm: Protein language model (PLM) embeddings combined with graph attention network (GAT)
models.input_features: Amino acid sequences encoded by PLM, then graph-based processing
models.candidate_reason: Only mentioned in review; combines PLM and GAT for antibacterial peptide prediction.

models.architecture_or_algorithm: Bidirectional LSTM with dropout and dense layer, sigmoid activation
models.input_features: One-hot encoded amino acid sequences, padded to length 20
models.dataset_source_or_link: CAMP, DBAASP, DRAMP, YADAMP, UniProt (as described in Methods)
models.candidate_reason: AMP classification model using bidirectional LSTM, described in fulltext, could be evaluated if code is available.
blocking_issues: Code not publicly available in a repository, only in Supplementary Materials; unclear if code is accessible.

models.architecture_or_algorithm: Bi-LSTM with multi-head scale dot-product attention and context attention, ensemble of 5 sub-models
models.dataset_source_or_link: Training data from APD, CAMP, etc. (details in paper); test set from Bullfrog genome and other sources.
models.candidate_reason: High-performance AMP prediction model with attention, publicly available code, directly comparable to other tools.

models.architecture_or_algorithm: Convolutional neural networks (CNN) based framework, two-stage: AMP identification and functional activity prediction, using one-hot, BLOSUM62, AAIndex, PAAC features.
models.input_features: One-hot encoding, BLOSUM62, AAIndex, PAAC encodings of peptide sequences
models.dataset_source_or_link: Integrated from multiple databases (APD3, dbAMP, DRAMP, etc.) and UniProt for negatives.
models.candidate_reason: Comprehensive AMP and functional activity prediction model, code available, suitable for benchmark.

important_evidence: AMPlify: attentive deep learning model, outperformed state-of-the-art, provides model files and training/test datasets (PMID 36732807, abstract)
MAPLE: integrates ESM-2 embeddings, achieves strong performance on AMP identification and 14 functional activities; code available (PMID 39927895, fulltext)
SGAC: graph neural network with OmegaFold 3D structures and contrastive learning; code and dataset available (PMID 41662353, fulltext)
Wang2021: bidirectional LSTM classifier for E. coli AMPs, validation accuracies 81.6–88.9% (PMID 33810011, fulltext)
AMPlify (2022): Bi-LSTM with attention, accuracy 93.71%, AUROC 98.37%, code available (PMID 35078402, fulltext)
iAMPCN: CNN-based two-stage predictor, comprehensive training/testing on 49k AMPs, code available (PMID 37369638, fulltext)
uncertainties: Full-text cache for PMID 36732807 (AMPlify) is incorrect; actual article needed to verify links and data availability.
Full-text for PMID 30867681 (review) mismatched with iFeature paper; actual review text needed.
Full-text for PMID 39927895 is MAPLE model paper, but title/abstract indicate a review; metadata may be mismatched.
Full-text for PMID 39705302 is an unrelated JBC article; actual paper describing DL method for E. coli AMP prediction not available.
SGAC paper's training and test datasets described as 'publicly available' but specific sources and download links not provided in excerpt.
All models mentioned in reviews (LMPred, AMPlify, TP-LMMSG, sAMPpred-GAT, PGAT-ABPp) require verification against original papers.
Code for Wang2021 model is in Supplementary Materials, unclear if publicly accessible.
No web server reported for AMPlify or iAMPCN.
